chats.answer:
If you're looking for the best large-format enclosed FDM 3D printer, I'd prioritize build volume, print reliability, chamber heating, and material compatibility—not just advertised speed.

For a large enclosed printer, I would generally look for at least a 300 × 300 × 300 mm build volume. If you regularly print large functional parts, 350–400 mm or more is preferable.

The best choice depends heavily on whether you're printing PLA/PETG, engineering materials like ABS/ASA/nylon, or carbon-fiber-reinforced filaments.
